Class AmwpFacade.PoolSink

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.ssh.AmwpFacade.PoolSink
All Implemented Interfaces:
PoolChat.Sink
Enclosing class:
AmwpFacade
private static final class AmwpFacade.PoolSink extends Object implements PoolChat.Sink
The PoolSink class sends frames for one pool prompt. A chunk that does not fit sends too-large and stops the prompt. Success sends the concatenated text, then EOF. A failure sends one error. A second frame does not leave.

    • done

      public void done(String reason, String message) throws Exception
      The done method finishes the pool prompt. A frame that already left returns without another frame. A token that is no longer live returns without another frame. An empty reason sends the message as channel stream type data, then type EOF. A message that does not fit replies too-large and does not send EOF. A non-empty reason sends one error through AmwpFacade.capPool(String, String).
      Specified by:
      done in interface PoolChat.Sink
      Parameters:
      reason - The reason is the pool reason, or empty on success.
      message - The message is the final text, or the failure text.
      Throws:
      Exception - The exception is a write failure.

    • forward

      private void forward(char kind, String text) throws Exception
      The forward method sends one pool chunk. A null or empty text returns without writing. A token that is no longer live returns without writing. A chunk that does not fit replies too-large once and throws PoolChat.TooLarge. A fitting chunk calls AmwpFacade.sendDelta(AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink, byte[], char, String).
      Parameters:
      kind - The kind is t or c.
      text - The text is the chunk.
      Throws:
      Exception - The exception is PoolChat.TooLarge, or a write failure.
